title: Research Brief
description: DISCOVER-stage artifact (absorption wave 1; open_deep_research recipe). Output of the deep_research operate mode: the supervisor decomposes the topic into perspective-split research angles (STORM-style principled split), each researcher's findings are compressed per-researcher before merging, and the brief records iterations used against the budget counters (max_iterations_without_new_evidence / max_fulltext_reads — the previously-dead budget knobs this mode wires live). Findings carry source_refs by reference only.

angle.description: The research angle this perspective owns (the principled split of the consolidated hunters).

findings.description: Per-perspective COMPRESSED findings (per-researcher compression before merge — the open_deep_research lesson).

summary.description: Compressed (<=2000 chars) — never a raw dump.

bottom_line.description: The director-facing one-paragraph answer: what should be believed or done now, with uncertainty.

consensus.description: Claims that multiple perspectives/sources agree on.

live_disagreements.description: Important disagreements, contradictions, or unsettled points.

actionable_next_questions.description: Next questions or experiments a researcher should run because of this brief.
